text: Sunshine! The Sun lights up our view. Swipe left or right to see what is outside.
Look at the flower! Sunlight helps plants grow.
A butterfly is visiting a flower. Watch its wings flutter.
The tree blocks some sunlight. Look at its shadow on the ground.
A little bird is outside our sunny window. Can you pretend to flap your wings?
Rain! Drops of water fall from clouds. Swipe left or right to explore our rainy view.
An umbrella helps keep the rain off. Look at the drops around it!
Rainwater has gathered in a puddle. Drip, drop! See the little ripples.
Rain boots help keep feet dry when we step outside.
Raindrops rest on the leaves. Plants need water to grow.
Wind! Moving air makes the branches sway. Swipe left or right to see things the wind can move.
The wind can lift a kite. A grown-up can help us fly one in an open space.
Look at the flag fluttering in the wind. Can you wave your hand like a flag?
The wind is carrying loose leaves. Watch them tumble through the air.
Moving air can turn a pinwheel. Round and round it goes!
Nighttime! Our view is dark and quiet. Swipe left or right to explore the night.
There is the Moon! The Moon reflects light from the Sun.
Stars shine in the night sky. Can you wiggle your fingers like twinkling stars?
A cat is watching the quiet street. Hello, little cat!
Lights glow inside the houses. The lights help people see when it is dark.
Snow! Little snowflakes fall on a cold day. Swipe left or right to explore our snowy view.
Someone has made a snowman. Look at the big snowballs stacked together!
A sled can slide over snow. A grown-up can help us find a safe place to ride.
Footprints show where someone walked through the snow. Can you follow them with your eyes?
A snowflake is made of ice. Look closely at its branching shape.
Fall is a season. Some trees change color and lose their leaves. Swipe left or right to explore our fall view.
Red, yellow, and orange leaves have fallen from the tree. Which color do you notice?
An acorn is a seed from an oak tree. A new oak tree can grow from it.
A round orange pumpkin is outside our window. Pumpkins grow on vines.
A squirrel is gathering food. Some squirrels store food to eat later.
